# MakeLanding

> > AI-powered landing page builder that generates beautiful, conversion-optimized pages instantly with AI copywriting, logos, and illustrations—no coding required.

MakeLanding is a no-code landing page generator powered by artificial intelligence, designed to help startups, entrepreneurs, and businesses launch professional landing pages in minutes. The platform offers industry-specific templates for SaaS, e-commerce, courses, podcasts, and more, with built-in AI copywriting and design automation.

## Key Topics

- AI landing page builder
- No-code tool
- AI copywriting
- Landing page generator
- Conversion optimization
- Design automation
- SaaS landing pages
- Template-based builder
- Automated copywriting
- Quick setup
- Startup-friendly
- Landing page templates
- E-commerce integration
- Shopify integration
- Lead generation

## Core Platform

- [Build Beautiful Landing Pages Instantly With AI](https://makelanding.ai): MakeLanding homepage: AI-powered landing page builder with instant copy, logos, and illustrations.
- [Create a New Landing Page](https://makelanding.ai/app/new): MakeLanding app interface for creating new landing pages with multilingual support.
- [Landing Page Design Gallery](https://makelanding.ai/design): Curated collection of 294 award-winning landing page design examples and inspiration.

- [Build an E-commerce Landing Page Instantly With AI](https://makelanding.ai/ecommerce): MakeLanding e-commerce landing page builder for product launches and sales.
- [Build a Podcast Landing Page Instantly With AI](https://makelanding.ai/podcast): MakeLanding podcast landing page builder with AI-generated headlines and images.

- [Build an eBook Landing Page Instantly With AI](https://makelanding.ai/ebook): MakeLanding eBook landing page builder for selling digital products.
